context: Two cafe friends plan a culture-themed evening
purpose: Teach: 刀/商人/平安/伝承/作物/納豆/薬局/ツリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今晩、平安時代をテーマにしたディナーに行くの。
lines.en: Tonight I'm going to a Heian-era themed dinner.
lines.style: Bright opening, genuine pleasure in the voice. Steady pace, almost conspiratorial—sharing something she's been looking forward to. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 素敵!古い刀の展示も併設してるんでしょ?
lines.en: How lovely! They have that old sword collection on display too, don't they?
lines.style: Warm and interested. Soft attack on the opening word. Leaning in slightly with genuine curiosity. The question carries genuine wanting-to-know, not just politeness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。地元商人の伝承、解説してくれるそう。
lines.en: Yeah. Apparently someone's going to explain the local merchant stories.
lines.style: More animated now, building on Aoi's interest. Light energy in the voice. Quick, engaged tempo. Slight breathiness suggesting she's genuinely involved in the moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 作物コーナーで、納豆の試食もあるって聞いた。
lines.en: And I heard they have natto tastings at the food stalls too.
lines.style: Cheerful and conversational. Bright tone without being forced. Casual, the rhythm of someone comfortable sharing interesting details. Light cadence on the discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 帰り、薬局で常備薬買って、家でゆっくり。
lines.en: On the way back I'll grab some medicine at the pharmacy, then just relax at home.
lines.style: Practical, grounded shift in tone. Slower pace—moving into self-care mode. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Slight trailing-off as if settling into the plan.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店のツリー、もう飾った?
lines.en: Have you put up the tree at your shop yet?
lines.style: Warm, intimate check-in. Gentle tone, genuine interest in Aoi's life. Soft attack. The rhythm of someone closing one conversation thread and opening another—unhurried, safe.
